jdk_xml_enableExtensionFunctions.description: Controls whether XSLT and XPath extension functions are allowed. Set to 'false' to disable.

jdk_xml_overrideDefaultParser.description: Controls whether a third-party implementation can override the default JDK parser.

jdk_xml_jdkcatalog_resolve.description: How the CatalogResolver behaves when unable to resolve an external reference. Options: continue, ignore, strict.

jdk_xml_dtd_support.description: Controls DTD processing. Options: deny, ignore, allow.

jdk_xml_entityExpansionLimit.description: Limits the number of entity expansions.

jdk_xml_totalEntitySizeLimit.description: Limits the total size of all entities.

jdk_xml_maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit.description: Limits the maximum size of any general entities.

jdk_xml_maxParameterEntitySizeLimit.description: Limits the maximum size of any parameter entities.

jdk_xml_entityReplacementLimit.description: Limits the total number of nodes in all entity references.

jdk_xml_elementAttributeLimit.description: Limits the number of attributes an element can have.

jdk_xml_maxOccurLimit.description: Limits the number of content model nodes for W3C XML Schema maxOccurs.

jdk_xml_maxXMLNameLimit.description: Limits the maximum size of XML names.

jdk_xml_xpathExprGrpLimit.description: Limits the number of groups an XPath expression can contain.

jdk_xml_xpathExprOpLimit.description: Limits the number of operators an XPath expression can contain.

jdk_xml_xpathTotalOpLimit.description: Limits the total number of XPath operators in an XSL Stylesheet.
